name: isChain_univ_iff
statement: IsChain r (univ : Set α) ↔ Std.Trichotomous r

have_tree.type: a ≠ b → (r a b ∨ r b a)

name: IsChain.preimage
statement: α → α → Prop) (s : β → β → Prop) (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) (h : ∀ x y, s (f x) (f y) → r x y) {c : Set β} (hrc : IsChain s c) : IsChain r (f ⁻¹' c)

have_tree.body: hrc ha hb (fun h ↦ hne (hf h))

name: succChain_spec
statement: ∃ t, IsChain r s ∧ SuperChain r s t) : SuperChain r s (SuccChain r s)

have_tree.type: IsChain r s ∧ SuperChain r s h.choose
